svg.title: Touch piano roll — phone (edit tool, chord selected, dragging with loupe) (PROPOSED · visual north star style)
svg.text: PROPOSED · not implemented · sizes are proposals pending measurement
Explicit tools with text labels. Current tool shown 3
ways: pressed chip, subtitle text, and grid hint.
Overview strip: 1-finger drag pans; the box is the visible
window. Rulers: drag time ruler = pan time; drag keys =
Loop brace handles [ ] are 48dp hit targets on the time
ruler; they snap to beats and edit the loop, never notes.
Loupe appears 96dp above the finger during any drag (flips
below near the top edge): ×2.5 view + pitch · position ·
Selected notes: thick outline + side handle tabs (outside
short notes so they stay ≥48dp to hit) + count in action
Velocity lane: stem height (not colour) shows velocity;
selected notes' stems are bold. Drag a stem, or use 'Vel
Action bar works on the selection — every drag has a tap
alternative (Len ±, nudge by arrows in the overflow, Vel
